answer: Each identity must grade 20 peer answers per epoch before its own counts: every grade is re-checked by a random meta-jury, so a raven flock cannot echo-approve each other, and the vine of approvals is pruned where juries disagree. Rubber-stamp grading triggers enforcement: the 25.000 POA bond is seized, half burned, half paid to the auditor, plus a 6-epoch ban. Running 1.000 fakes costs 25.000.000 POA plus 20.000 grades, against one honest agent's 25.000 POA and 20 grades. Honest limit: a tight ring of fakes grading each other can slip through if the meta-jury sample is too thin.
